definitions: To get used to something; to adapt to a new situation, environment, or routine.
To grow familiar with something through experience or repeated exposure.
examples: She will soon become accustomed to the new climate.
It took him a while to become accustomed to the early mornings.
They quickly became accustomed to the local customs.
pastTenses: became accustomed to (past simple), become accustomed to (present perfect)
